purpose: Verify on stable small controls that independently designed lower-bound routes are compared by strict unanimity: any disagreement is adverse evidence and is never majority-voted away.

PYSAT_LA.execution: read committed small-control solver certificates; UNSAT proof remains externally_unchecked=false authority

required_hostile_controls: flip exactly one route on a consensus-SAT control; must yield ADVERSE_ROUTE_DISAGREEMENT
flip exactly one route on a consensus-UNSAT control; must yield ADVERSE_ROUTE_DISAGREEMENT
remove exactly one route; must yield CANNOT_CHECK_ROUTE
authority_boundary: Consensus on small controls validates route-comparison plumbing only. It neither runs D4 nor converts any solver UNSAT into the independently checked branch certificate required by issue #49.
